fusions.name: Pounce on the Line
fusions.desc: You rush up to 6 tiles to the target, which takes 15 damage and is left 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Web Spray
fusions.desc: Sprays a cone of strands that deals 3 damage to everything in it, with a 40% chance of [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hide the Party
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 8 seconds. Enemies notice you at 40% of the usual rate and you move 10% faster; the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Taut Strands
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.
